criteria.B_database_phase_mapping_stability: every raw phase maps into the frozen five families; unmappable or pathological target fraction < 0.20
criteria.C_chemical_topology_complementarity: greedy max-min Jensen-Shannon distance of the dominant X-partition topology distribution, against the existing six elements AND the already-selected pilot elements
criteria.D_not_all_same_topology: the selected set must contain at least two distinct modal topologies
criteria.E_not_dominated_by_OTHER_SOLID: at most floor(n/2) selected elements may be OTHER_DOMINATED
criteria.F_materials_plausibility: STEP5F-0 plausibility_level is carried through; LOW plausibility cannot be selected
criteria.G_maximize_chemical_identity_diversity: a candidate that contributes a modal topology NOT already present in the selected set is preferred over one that duplicates an existing modal topology, before the JS ordering is consulted. Without this, a greedy max-min rule can add an element whose topology distribution is identical to one already selected (JS = 0), which adds no chemical identity at all.

core_retention.rule: Be / Sn / Mn are seeded FIRST if they are eligible AND convergence >= 0.98. This is a preference, not an absolute requirement (spec 31); a core element that is TECHNICALLY_UNSTABLE is not selected.

forbidden: selection based on Ni similarity, Ni expected phase behaviour or Ni proximity (spec 30)
treating high topology entropy as automatically better (spec 23)
auto-excluding a near-degenerate or OTHER-dominated element (spec 25, 26)
tie_break_order: contributes a modal topology not yet in the selected set
larger minimum JS distance to the existing six and the already-selected set
